dialogue.origin: （本日はよろしくお願いします。時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きます。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for coming today. We'll begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。まず初めに・ご年齢と性別・今日ご相談したいことについて　教えていただけますか。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in for a consultation. First, could you please tell me your age and gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 53才 女性
dialogue.content: 53 years old, female.

dialogue.origin: 今日は母の介護の事での相談です。
dialogue.content: Today I'd like to consult with you about caring for my mother.

dialogue.origin: はいありがとうございます。お母さまの介護について、ですね。具体的にはどうのような内容でしょうか。教えてくださいますか。
dialogue.content: Thank you. So, it's about caring for your mother. Could you tell me more specifically about the situation?

dialogue.origin: 現在、フルタイムで仕事をしながら、母の世話をしております。
dialogue.content: Currently, I'm taking care of my mother while working full-time.

dialogue.origin: 介護というのは少し語弊がありますが、週3日は母が透析に通っているため、在宅での勤務をしております。
dialogue.content: "Caregiving" might be a bit of a strong word, but because my mother has dialysis three times a week, I work from home on those days.

dialogue.origin: フルタイムでお仕事されながら、在宅勤務で、透析中のお母さまと生活されているのですね。
dialogue.content: So you're living with your mother, who is on dialysis, while working full-time from home.

dialogue.origin: 週三回の透析時はお仕事はどうされているのですか？
dialogue.content: How do you manage your work during her three dialysis sessions a week?

dialogue.origin: 会社への出社は週2日なのですが、ここのところ色々な病院への付き添いが増えて週2日の出社でもお休みを頂くことがあり
dialogue.content: I go to the office twice a week, but lately I've had to accompany her to various hospital appointments more often, so I sometimes have to take time off even on those two office days.

dialogue.origin: はいそうです。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 週3日の透析の日は自宅で仕事をしております。
dialogue.content: On the three days a week she has dialysis, I work from home.

dialogue.origin: 月水金は午前中が母の透析の時間となりますので、その日は終日自宅で勤務です。
dialogue.content: My mother has dialysis on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings, so I work from home all day on those days.

dialogue.origin: では透析は外来等ではなく、ご自宅でできる透析でしょうか。それとも送迎での透析でしょうか。
dialogue.content: So, is the dialysis done at home, rather than at an outpatient clinic? Or is transportation provided?

dialogue.origin: 透析の時は病院が母を迎えにきてくださるので送り出しと迎えのみです。
dialogue.content: For dialysis, the hospital picks my mother up, so I just need to see her off and welcome her back.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。なかなかハードな生活になりますね。このような生活になってどのくらいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. That sounds like a very demanding life. How long has it been like this?

dialogue.origin: もともと一人でできていたのですが、不在時に転倒、大腿骨骨折の怪我をしてから、透析後に一人にするのは心配で、透析の日は在宅をするようになりました。
dialogue.content: She used to be able to manage on her own, but after she fell and fractured her femur while I was out, I became worried about leaving her alone after dialysis, so I started working from home on those days.

dialogue.origin: 昨年の7月に骨折、9/30に退院してから10月には在宅ワークをするようになったかと思います。
dialogue.content: She fractured her femur last July, was discharged on September 30th, and I believe I started working from home in October.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…骨折された後は、何かあったらと思うと、心配ですよね。
dialogue.content: I see... After a fracture like that, it's natural to worry that something might happen again.

dialogue.origin: お二人で生活されているのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Are the two of you living together?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。骨折後も転倒をすることもあるのでなかなか目を離せなくなりました。
dialogue.content: That's right. She still falls sometimes, even after the fracture, so it's become hard to take my eyes off her.

dialogue.origin: はい。二人でくらしております。
dialogue.content: Yes, we live together, just the two of us.

dialogue.origin: そうなると、ご相談者さまの気が休まる時がないのでは…と思いますね。
dialogue.content: In that case, I imagine you hardly have a moment to relax.

dialogue.origin: はい。そうですね。もともと色々と相談をしていたのですが、3ヶ月近い入院で人の世話になりたくないといわれて、ケアマネをアサインしてもらっていたのですが、連絡をしなくなってしまったので、いざ電話をしたときに電話にでてもらえず、それからは相談をしてません。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true. I had been consulting with various people, but after she was hospitalized for nearly three months, she said she didn't want to be taken care of by others. We had a care manager assigned, but my mother stopped contacting them. When I eventually tried to call, they didn't pick up, so I haven't sought advice since.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。退院後から支援を受けたい、相談したいと思っても繋がれない　というご状況でしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. So the situation is that since her discharge, you've wanted to get support and advice, but you haven't been able to connect with anyone?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。もともと退院後はケアマネのお世話になりたいの事前に段取りをしておりましたが、母が3ヶ月の入院の間に、病院でいろんな方の世話になったことで、逆に人に迷惑をかけたくないと感じたのか、退院する直前は“今は一人になりたい“と言われてしまい、頼むことができませんでした。
dialogue.content: That's right. We had originally arranged to get help from a care manager after her discharge. However, I think because she was cared for by so many people during her three-month hospital stay, she started to feel like she didn't want to be a bother to anyone. Just before she was discharged, she told me, "I want to be alone for now," so I couldn't go through with the arrangement.

dialogue.origin: 母も一番精神的につらいじきだったと思います。
dialogue.content: I think that was the most emotionally difficult time for my mother as well.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、お母さまの意思を大事にされたのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, you respected your mother's wishes.

dialogue.origin: 今は何とかご自宅で生活ができていて、どうですか？お母さまは安定されていますか。
dialogue.content: Now that she's managing to live at home, how are things going? Is your mother's condition stable?

dialogue.origin: コロナでもあったので、面会もほぼできない状況での入院生活で、本当はリハビリでもう少し入院予定でしたが、精神的に限界を越えていたので、とにかく早く退院させることを最後は考えてました。
dialogue.content: It was also during the pandemic, so she was hospitalized with almost no visitors allowed. She was actually scheduled to stay longer for rehabilitation, but she had reached her mental limit, so in the end, my main focus was on getting her discharged as soon as possible.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。今は精神的に落ち着いて昨年のような精神状態はかなりよいと思います。
dialogue.content: That's right. She's mentally much more stable now, and her state of mind is much better than it was last year.

dialogue.origin: 3か月、転倒し痛い思いもし、やっと帰れたご自宅ですもんね。相談者様の支えがあってこそ、ですね。
dialogue.content: After three months, experiencing a painful fall, she was finally able to return home. It's truly thanks to your support.

dialogue.origin: 年なので体力はありませんので、病院に行くのももちろん一人では行けませんので、車で連れていってという感じです。今は五十肩？？の治療で毎週市外の専門医に連れて行っております。
dialogue.content: Because of her age, she doesn't have much physical strength, so of course she can't go to the hospital by herself; I have to drive her. Right now, I'm taking her every week to a specialist outside the city for treatment for what seems to be a frozen shoulder.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。透析＋痛みの緩和もできるよう通っていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So in addition to her dialysis, she's also going for treatment to manage her pain.

dialogue.origin: 毎日のこと、本当にご苦労様です。
dialogue.content: That's a lot to manage every day. I truly commend you for your efforts.

dialogue.origin: よく転倒をしていたのですが(体力がないので)、前よりはみていることができるので、大怪我にはならなくなりました。
dialogue.content: She used to fall often because she lacks physical strength, but now that I'm able to watch her more closely, she hasn't had any major injuries.

dialogue.origin: ええ。ご自身で家の中は自由に過ごされている感じでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. Does she seem to be able to get around the house freely on her own?

dialogue.origin: 相談者様がお仕事へ出勤される日はデイサービスなども利用されず、ご自宅でお一人？
dialogue.content: On the days you go into the office, does she stay at home alone, without using a day service or anything similar?

dialogue.origin: 前に比べてソファーなども大きくして部屋の中が狭くなるように、動線を限られたところにした関係であまり転ばなくはなりましたが、めまいを起こすことがあるので、それが心配なのと
dialogue.content: Compared to before, I've gotten a bigger sofa and made other changes to narrow the room and limit her pathways, so she doesn't fall as much. But she sometimes gets dizzy, which is a concern.

dialogue.origin: 基本的に血圧が低いので気持ちが悪くて寝てしまうことや、夜は特にご飯を食べずに寝てしまうことがあるのもちょっと困ります
dialogue.content: Her blood pressure is generally low, so she sometimes feels unwell and just goes to bed. It's also a bit of a problem that she sometimes goes to bed without eating dinner.

dialogue.origin: 自宅では将棋がすきで、将棋番組を自分の携帯でみていたり。
dialogue.content: At home, she likes shogi and watches shogi programs on her phone.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。転倒しにくい環境を整えたり工夫できることはされているのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you've already made efforts and adjustments to create an environment where she's less likely to fall.

dialogue.origin: 私が仕事の日は一人でおります。
dialogue.content: On the days I go into the office, she's at home by herself.

dialogue.origin: ご自身の好きな時間も過ごせてはいるようですね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like she's also able to spend time doing things she enjoys.

dialogue.origin: デイサービスとかに行ってくれればよいのですが、もともとあまり社交的というタイプではないので。
dialogue.content: It would be nice if she would go to a day service, but she's not a very social person to begin with.

dialogue.origin: お一人の時間がやはり心配…といったところでしょうか。
dialogue.content: So, the main concern is the time she spends alone, is that right?

dialogue.origin: それもあるのでケアマネという話をしたときに難色を示したのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: That might be another reason why she was hesitant when I brought up the idea of a care manager.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。入院中に様々な思いもされたかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: That's true. She may have gone through many different thoughts and feelings while she was in the hospital.

dialogue.origin: 一人の時間は心配ですね。冷蔵庫の扉を開けただけで、そのドアが自分に向かってきただけで、身体を支えきれず倒れたことがあるくらいなので。
dialogue.content: Yes, I worry when she's alone. She once fell simply from opening the refrigerator door; she couldn't support her own weight when the door swung toward her.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様としては、サービスを利用しながらご自宅での時間を少しでも過ごしたい　というお気持ちなのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: From your perspective, is the hope that by using some support services, your mother can continue to spend as much time at home as possible?

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれませんね。入院中に自分でできないことが多かったので本当に辛かったのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: That might be it. There were many things she couldn't do for herself in the hospital, so it must have been very hard for her.

dialogue.origin: どちらかというと人に頼らずに自分のことは自分でしたいと思っている人なので。
dialogue.content: If anything, she's the type of person who wants to do things for herself without relying on others.

dialogue.origin: ええ。それがお母さまの生きる力とも言えますね。それを支えていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: Yes. You could say that's her source of strength. And you're the one supporting that.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。いま、週2日の出社日でも母が病院に行きたければ付き添っておりますので、もしそういうことを多少お願いできると助かるというか。
dialogue.content: That's right. Right now, even on my two in-office days, I'll accompany my mother if she needs to go to the hospital. It would be a huge help if I could ask someone else to do that sometimes.

dialogue.origin: 3ヶ月に1回は透析をしている腕の血管の検査に病院に行くので必ず休まなくてはいけません。
dialogue.content: Once every three months, I have to take time off work to take her to the hospital for a vascular check on the arm she uses for dialysis.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。生活自体もご相談者様がお支えされていますし。お仕事を継続させていくためにも、何らかのサービスは必要かもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: That's right. You're supporting her entire life, after all. In order to continue your own work, some kind of service may be necessary.

dialogue.origin: 整形外科も3ヶ月にら1回、大腿骨の経過をみるために連れていっておりますが、これは土曜日なのでまだよいのですが。
dialogue.content: I also take her to the orthopedist once every three months for a follow-up on her femur, but that's on a Saturday, so it's more manageable.

dialogue.origin: 受診も多いと一日終わってしまいますね。お母さまのご意思をこれまでご相談者様は大事にされてこられて、
dialogue.content: With so many appointments, the whole day can just disappear. You have always respected your mother's wishes, and...

dialogue.origin: ご相談者さまのお気持ちやお考えはお母さまに話されたことはあるのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: ...have you ever spoken to your mother about your own feelings and thoughts on the matter?

dialogue.origin: 五十肩の通院は自宅から１時間くらい車で行くところに毎週土曜日に通うようになってしまい。入れ歯の状態もよくないので、歯医者にいかなくては、これは平日なのかしら？など色々と考えると日にちも時間もなくなる・・
dialogue.content: For her frozen shoulder, we've started going to a clinic about an hour's drive away every Saturday. Her dentures aren't in good shape either, so she needs to see a dentist, and I wonder if that will have to be on a weekday... When I think about all these things, the days and hours just run out.

dialogue.origin: あるような、ないような、みたいな。
dialogue.content: Kind of, but not really.

dialogue.origin: 私しかたよることができないので、できる限りの無理は聞いてあげたいと想う反面という気持ちなのです
dialogue.content: Since I'm the only one she can rely on, there's a part of me that wants to do everything I can for her, but at the same time...

dialogue.origin: そうですか…お話伺っていますと、相談者様が倒れてしまってはお二人での大事にしたい生活が壊れてしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: I see... Listening to you, it seems that if you were to collapse from exhaustion, the life you both cherish together would fall apart.

dialogue.origin: お気遣い頂いてありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for your concern.

dialogue.origin: 母は体力はないのですが、頭は私よりもよっぽどしっかりしていて。
dialogue.content: My mother may not have much physical strength, but her mind is much sharper than mine.

dialogue.origin: 本当にご相談者様、お優しいですね。ストレス発散等、何かできていますか？
dialogue.content: You are truly a very kind person. Are you able to do anything to relieve your own stress?

dialogue.origin: 今回の市外の病院ももともと透析の血管がつまりかけていたので手術をする必要がしょうじたのですが、腕が五十肩であがらず、先生に手術までに治してくるように言われて、自分で携帯で検索して肩の専門医を捜して、仕事中に病院を見つけたからいついけるか電話してほしいと連絡があって、私が病院に電話してというかんじなのです。
dialogue.content: Regarding the out-of-town hospital, she needed surgery because the blood vessel for her dialysis was getting clogged. But she couldn't raise her arm due to her frozen shoulder, and the doctor told her to get that fixed before the surgery. So, she searched for a shoulder specialist on her phone by herself, found a hospital, and then contacted me at work, asking me to call them to see when she could go. So I was the one who called the hospital.

dialogue.origin: 推しがいるのでお友達と推し話をしたり、音楽を聞いたり、YouTubeをみたりじぶんの時間もあります。
dialogue.content: I have someone I'm a big fan of, so I have my own time to talk about them with friends, listen to music, and watch YouTube.

dialogue.origin: それは、確かにしっかりされていますね。十二分に社会と繋がっていらっしゃる。じぶん時間も上手にとられているのですね。
dialogue.content: She certainly is sharp, isn't she? She's more than capable of connecting with society. And it seems you're good at making time for yourself as well.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。しっかりしています。私自身は自分の時間はしっかりとっているつもりです。
dialogue.content: Yes, she is. As for me, I believe I'm taking enough time for myself.

dialogue.origin: 毎日のことですがお母さまと感情的にケンカになることなどもなく、平穏に過ごせているのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Since this is a daily reality, are you generally able to live together peacefully, without getting into emotional arguments with your mother?

dialogue.origin: あまりケンカになることはないのですが、まれに勝手なこといわないでというように私が怒っていることがあります。
dialogue.content: We don't fight very often, but on rare occasions, I do get angry and say something like, "Don't be so selfish."

dialogue.origin: あとで申し訳ないなと反省するのですが。
dialogue.content: I feel bad about it afterwards, though.

dialogue.origin: 基本的には平穏に過ごしております
dialogue.content: But basically, we live together peacefully.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。「勝手なこといわないで」は自然な感情だと思います。ご自身を責められることもなくて大丈夫だと思います。なかなかお伺いしていて、できないことだなと率直に思います。
dialogue.content: I understand. Saying "Don't be so selfish" is a completely natural feeling. There's no need to blame yourself. Frankly, as I listen to your story, I think what you're doing is something not many people could do.

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話しされてみて、どうなったらいいかなとお考えでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Now that we've talked through all of this, what kind of outcome are you hoping for?

dialogue.origin: 自分の実の親ですし、私と違い頭がよい人なので、子供の時から尊敬していたので。口うるさくもあったので嫌いな時期もありましたけど。
dialogue.content: She's my own mother, and unlike me, she's very smart, so I've respected her since I was a child. Though there was a time I disliked her because she could be very nagging.

dialogue.origin: ええ（お話しくださいね）
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. (Please continue.)

dialogue.origin: そうですね。色々と高齢者の何かに相談してみてもいいなかなぁと。
dialogue.content: Well... I'm starting to think it might be a good idea to consult some kind of service for the elderly.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。ご相談者さまに何かあってからでは遅いので、今のうちから繋がっておくことは必要かもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: I agree. It would be too late if something were to happen to you, so it might be necessary to get connected with some support now.

dialogue.origin: 入院直後は母の気持ちかなり不安定だったと思うので今なら少しは聞いてもらえるのか、変わらないのか。
dialogue.content: My mother was very emotionally unstable right after her hospitalization. I wonder if she might be a bit more receptive now, or if she's still the same.

dialogue.origin: こちらでは専門外のため情報提供はできないのですが、
dialogue.content: I can't provide specific information as it's outside my area of expertise, but...

dialogue.origin: そうですね。確かに、何かあったときに繋がっていないと不安ですね。
dialogue.content: That's true. It's unsettling to think about not being connected to any support in case something happens.

dialogue.origin: 今繋がろうとされているケアマネではなく、今はどこの自治体にも地域包括ケアという場所もございますし
dialogue.content: Instead of the care manager you were trying to connect with before, every municipality now has something called a Community General Support Center.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様とお母さんの実情を第三者に知っておいてもらうことは
dialogue.content: Having a third party who is aware of your and your mother's actual situation...

dialogue.origin: 高齢者の地域包括センターとかありましたよね。
dialogue.content: There are those Community Comprehensive Support Centers for the elderly, right?

dialogue.origin: 何かあったら…の時の心の支えになるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: ...it might become a source of emotional support for you when you're worried about "what if."

dialogue.origin: そこに相談をしてケアマネを紹介してもらいました。そこで介護認定の段取りもしてもらいました。
dialogue.content: I consulted one of those places before and they introduced me to a care manager. They also helped arrange for her to be certified for long-term care.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: はい、市役所等に電話しても大丈夫ですし、ご自身で近くの地域包括支援センターに電話されても大丈夫かと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, you can call city hall, or I think you could also call a nearby Community Comprehensive Support Center directly.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。また電話してみます。何かに母にあった支援がどういったものか相談してみます。
dialogue.content: You're right. I'll try calling again. I'll consult with them about what kind of support would be suitable for my mother.

dialogue.origin: 何かに母にあった支援
dialogue.content: Support that suits my mother...

dialogue.origin: 何かですね。すみません、何度も誤記が。
dialogue.content: I meant "what kind." Sorry for the repeated typos.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: No, no, it's fine.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お母さまと支援する側の相性も実はあったりしますよね。お母さまとご相談者様を理解してくれている環境を作っておくことは、
dialogue.content: You know, the compatibility between your mother and the support provider is a real factor. Creating an environment where there's someone who understands both you and your mother...

dialogue.origin: これからの続いていく生活の支えになるかと思います。
dialogue.content: ...will be a great support for your life going forward.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。いいかたに巡り会えるといいのですが。
dialogue.content: That's true. I hope we can find someone good.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。叔父も人見知りがすごくてあまり他人を受け入れないひとだったのですが、最後は一人ぐらいで、面倒をみてもらっていたのですが、きてくれたケアマネがいい方で本当に穏やかに老後を過ごしてました。
dialogue.content: That's right. My uncle was also very shy and didn't readily accept strangers, but in the end, he was being looked after by one person. The care manager who came was a wonderful person, and he was able to spend his last years very peacefully.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。気難しい点などは誰にでもあることですし、ご縁がきっと、ありますように。
dialogue.content: I see. Everyone can be difficult in their own way. I truly hope you find a good connection.

dialogue.origin: 私の方で連絡して今後を考えたいと思います。
dialogue.content: I'll contact them myself and think about the next steps.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はいそうですね。そろそろお時間になりましたね。本日はご相談におこしいただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's a good plan. It looks like our time is almost up. Thank you very much for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、お世話になりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: No, thank you. I appreciate your help.

dialogue.origin: また何かありましたらお越しいただければと思います。それでは終了メッセージを送らせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Please feel free to come back if anything else comes up. I will now send the closing message.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。勉強になりました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you. This was a valuable learning experience.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.
